candidate: Luo et al. 2022 Tvärminne Daphnia rock-pool metacommunity

scientific_role_evidence.paper_statement: The published model defines A_i as patch size and d_ij as pairwise distance between patches; the empirical system contains 546 rock-pool patches.
scientific_role_evidence.archive_separation: A.csv and distance.csv are distinct archive members from data_L.csv, data_M.csv and data_P.csv.
scientific_role_evidence.canonical_member_choice: Use the Bayesian model fitting copies. Identical duplicate copies exist under plot/ with matching CRC32 values.
scientific_role_evidence.claim_boundary: This gate establishes response-independent patch-size and pairwise-distance inputs only. It does not establish occupancy, colonisation events, missingness resolution, biological dispersal scale or historical routes.

geometry_pass_requires: both selected members are extracted only by bounded HTTP Range requests using their frozen ZIP local-header offsets and central-directory sizes
member names, CRC32 values and uncompressed sizes match the frozen inventory
A.csv resolves to exactly 546 finite positive patch-size values after removal of at most deterministic row/column labels
distance.csv resolves to a 546 x 546 finite non-negative symmetric matrix with near-zero diagonal after removal of at most deterministic row/column labels
no data_L.csv, data_M.csv, data_P.csv, post_sample.csv or other response-bearing member bytes are downloaded
next_if_pass: Build the unchanged response-blind structural LCC scale ladder from the frozen pairwise-distance matrix before any Daphnia occupancy row is opened.
no_rescue: do not inspect occupancy members to repair patch IDs or geometry
do not change the 546-node universe after outcome access
do not use fitted Daphnia dispersal parameters to choose structural worlds
do not add a candidate-specific connectivity operator
